unit.why: A narrative: the master (מרן) foresaw, through the readings of the twelve Nesi'im in Nisan, his wife's death and his daughter's death in childbirth. He dreamed of the daughter's death, and the prediction was confirmed to a witness.
unit.boundary_note: next division continues the same theme (R. Elazar of Kozienice's testimony)

stories.start_quote: נודע כי מרן ז"ל היה יודע
stories.summary_en: The master could foresee each month of the year while reading the twelve Nesi'im in Nisan. He thus foresaw his wife's death in Nisan and his daughter's death in the third month, dreamed that she died in childbirth, and a man confirmed he had been told of it before Pesach.

זוכר אתה מה שאמרתי לך קודם פסח
